scientific_integrity: The rate-universal leading coefficient is proved by an exact two-stage exponential race and Laplace expansion. A separately implemented finite-state recursion verifies finite instances. Numerical diagnostics do not prove asymptotics. Historical priority remains subject to independent comparison.
scientific_limitations: Two permanent competing exponential-rate infections begin at different peripheral vertices of deterministic K_{2,n}; two hubs, fixed positive rates, no recovery. The formula and asymptotics do not extend as stated to random configurations, varying rates, other initial placements, or larger cores.
title: Rate-universal square-root coexistence in two-type infection on \(K_{2,n}\)
